name: Alcaldía de Neiva
body: Every page analyzed has a meta description, framing is limited to its origin, and nosniff is sent. But all 500 URLs in /sitemap.xml sit on www.neiva.gov.co, which did not answer, not on www.alcaldianeiva.gov.co.
lesson: Build the sitemap from the live domain; spot-check it after a move or rebrand.
summary: www.alcaldianeiva.gov.co scores 64 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 500 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: www.neiva.gov.co (500). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.alcaldianeiva.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 43 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /Paginas/index.aspx, /Gestion/Paginas/Gesti%C3%B3n-de-tramites-y-servicios.aspx, /Ciudadanos/Paginas/Tr%C3%A1mites-Servicios.aspx, /Ciudadanos/Paginas/Notificacion-a-Terceros.aspx. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /Paginas/Inicio.aspx answered 404, linked from /Paginas/index.aspx, /NuestraAlcaldia/Paginas/Mapa-de-Sitio.aspx and 4 more. /Ciudadanos/Paginas/Sistema-de-PQRSD.aspx answered 404, linked from /Paginas/index.aspx, /NuestraAlcaldia/Paginas/Mapa-de-Sitio.aspx…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 21 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
